dct_creator_sm: Moody, Richard Clement (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: THIS IS A GEOREFERENCED FILE. Map of the Lower Mainland of British Columbia from the U.S.-Canada border to Seaton Lake in the north and from the coast to Similkameen River and Vermillion. Using red ink to show a network of different kinds of trails mostly adjacent to the Fraser River and other rivers including trails proposed by Colonel Moody, old Hudson's Bay Company trails, trails in progress, mule trails, trails in need of improvement, and trails to/from different points in the U.S
